title: MEP Technical Engineer
description:

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As an MEP Technical Engineer, you'll work alongside project leaders to ensure technical documents meet precise specifications, coordinate on-site execution, and uphold the quality of all MEP works. From pre-construction planning to close-out documentation, you'll help keep projects running smoothly and compliantly.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

Your Role

  • Support Project Engineers in planning MEP systems for efficient project delivery
  • Prepare and review technical submittals, including drawings, materials, calculations, method statements, and reports
  • Maintain accuracy and completeness of technical documentation
  • Monitor and track submittal approvals to uphold timelines and quality expectations
  • Coordinate with other disciplines to ensure integrated site execution
  • Provide timely resolutions to site technical issues
  • Conduct site inspections to monitor work progress and compliance
  • Ensure installations meet local and international codes, standards, and project specifications
  • Assist with quantity take-offs, procurement, and logistics of MEP materials
  • Contribute to as-built documentation and final handover packages
  • Participate in meetings and maintain clear communication with all stakeholders
  • Pursue continuous learning through courses, seminars, and certifications

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (required)
  • 5 years of technical experience in MEP construction
  • Solid knowledge of MEP systems and design processes
  • Proficiency in MS Office; experience with Revit preferred
  • Familiarity with Autodesk tools and collaborative platforms
  • Strong understanding of design techniques and emerging technologies
  • Knowledge of relevant international and regional codes and standards
  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to Lead?

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.
